description: Preview a content campaign for a product BEFORE launching it. FREE — nothing is created and no credits are charged. Returns an AI-drafted campaign (title, description, call-to-action) plus whether the user can afford to launch it (1000 credits). Show the user the draft AND the credit cost, get an explicit yes, then call create_content_campaign — never launch off the back of the preview alone. Requires a product_id from search_products; write the campaign_message brief from what you know about the product.

campaign_message.description: The core brief: what you want the community to create (e.g. 'Share how you use <product> in your daily workflow').

references.description: Links or references to include in the campaign

name: suggest_content_campaign
title: Preview a content campaign
